Package gov.Lab3

Class Designer

java.lang.Object
gov.Lab3.Person
gov.Lab3.Designer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Profile, Comparable<Profile>
public class Designer extends Person
A Person who is also a visual or UX designer.

In addition to the base person data, a Designer tracks the list of design artefacts they have created.
